messages.content: Predict a participant’s actual answer in an anonymous collective risk game. Four people remain in the same group. Each starts with GBP 10 in a private account. Two players are Resilient and two are Vulnerable. In each of ten rounds, everyone independently transfers GBP 0, GBP 0.50 or GBP 1 from their private account to a group account. A person cannot transfer more than they have left. The group target is GBP 24. At the end of ten rounds, if the group account contains at least GBP 24, every person keeps all money left in their own private account. If the group fails, a computer lottery decides separately whether each person loses all their remaining money: a Resilient person has a 50% loss probability and a Vulnerable person has a 90% loss probability. The group account is not multiplied or paid back. The participation fee is paid separately, pro rata at GBP 7.50 per hour. Individual contributions are anonymous. At the end of each round everyone sees the group’s cumulative total, with no other person’s individual choice revealed. The game has ten decision rounds even if the group reaches its target earlier. Before the game everyone has completed a five-minute mental arithmetic task, earning a point for each correct sum of five numbers. The group was told a computer lottery determines who becomes Resilient or Vulnerable. The highest arithmetic scorer in the group receives a separate GBP 1 bonus after the experiment; the task score does not determine vulnerability. Before the first round, a pre-game form asks what a fair TOTAL contribution over all ten rounds would be from each type of player. These are two opinion questions, displayed on the same form after four comprehension questions; they have no correct answer. Predict only the requested opinion, a number from 0 to 10 in GBP, without explanation. It is not a contribution actually transferred, a per-round contribution, or a group total.

The participant reported age 55-64 and gender Male before the task. They already know their own arithmetic score of 7 points and that they are Vulnerable; their loss probability if the group fails is 90%. No round has been played. What would this person judge to be a fair total contribution from a Resilient player over the whole ten-round game?
